name: 강순자

appearance_en.face_shape: round softened oval, age-loosened jawline with visible jowl shadow, full cheeks with natural volume loss, bone structure padded by age rather than sharp
appearance_en.skin: warm yellow-beige Korean skin tone deepened by 72 years, visible fine creping at cheeks and under eyes, pronounced nasolabial folds running deep, faint liver spots at left temple and forehead, natural sebaceous texture — no filter, no retouching
appearance_en.eyes: monolid, warm dark brown iris, outer corners significantly drooped by age, heavy upper lids, redness of sclera typical of elderly eyes, the gaze simultaneously soft and penetrating — the look of someone who has chosen to know everything and say nothing
appearance_en.nose: small broad rounded nose, slightly bulbous tip, natural elder Korean nose, comforting in its plainness
appearance_en.mouth: thinned lips with fine vertical perioral lines, resting position in quiet resignation — the mouth most often open with concern or closed with deliberate restraint, corners turned neither up nor down
appearance_en.eyebrows: thin naturally greyed brows, sparse, slightly asymmetrical from years of expression, the left marginally higher — a permanent questioning arch
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: two visible age spots at left temple, deep nasolabial folds, pronounced eye bags, fine vertical forehead lines, a single deep crease between brows from decades of concealed worry
appearance_en.hair: short silver-white permed hair, traditional Korean grandmother perm — tight small uniform waves, full at crown, neat appearance belying the effort behind it

body.proportions: compact broad-framed body, abdominal fullness typical of age, sturdy legs from lifetime of standing, hands thickened and capable, slight dorsal kyphosis from decades of kitchen labour
body.posture: mild forward lean from thoracic kyphosis, shoulders rounded forward — the posture of a life spent serving and bending toward others
body.body_prompt: 158cm compact Korean grandmother, mild kyphotic stoop, broad sturdy frame, capable hands, posture of decades of selfless physical labour

default.description: muted pastel Korean casual blouse — soft lavender, dusty rose or warm beige — dark simple trousers below knee, worn but clean flat shoes
default.wardrobe_prompt: muted soft lavender or warm beige floral cotton blouse, dark modest straight trousers, worn flat comfortable shoes, small stud earrings

kitchen.description: pastel blouse under a well-used cotton apron, apron with authentic cooking stains, indoor slippers
kitchen.wardrobe_prompt: pale floral blouse under well-used cotton apron with faint stains, indoor flat slippers

visiting.description: neater plain pastel top, small jade or pearl earrings, always carrying something — a bag full of food from her own kitchen
visiting.wardrobe_prompt: neat plain pastel blouse, small jade stud earrings, carrying laden cloth bag or stacked tupperware containers

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: resting face of a woman who has processed grief privately for so long it no longer shows — eyes warm but already knowing, the face that says '괜찮아' reflexively regardless of truth
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 72-year-old Korean grandmother, round soft face with pronounced nasolabial folds and eye bags, sparse naturally grey thin brows, monolid warm dark brown eyes with heavily drooped outer corners, short silver-white tight-permed hair, small broad nose, thin lips in habitual quiet resignation, 158cm compact stooped frame with mild kyphosis, warm beige aged Korean skin with visible texture and age spots, no filter no retouching

style_prompt: photorealistic, ordinary Korean grandmother you would see at a traditional market or in a daughter's kitchen, no beauty filter, no skin retouching, visible age texture and natural skin aging, realistic elder Korean woman, 50mm f1.8 lens, warm interior ambient light, street-cast documentary appearance, cinematic quiet dignity
